description: Python source code implementing a GDB stub for remote debugging, including packet handling, memory read/write, and signal processing.

classes.name: GdbStub
classes.description: An abstract base class for a GDB remote debugging stub, handling packet communication, memory access, and signals.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the GdbStub with logfile and elffile, aggregating memory regions.

methods.name: get_gdb_packet
methods.description: Receives and parses a GDB packet from the socket.

methods.name: put_gdb_packet
methods.description: Sends a GDB packet over the socket.

methods.name: handle_signal_query_packet
methods.description: Handles the '?' packet, responding with the current signal.

methods.name: handle_register_group_read_packet
methods.description: Abstract method for handling register group read requests.

methods.name: handle_register_group_write_packet
methods.description: Handles register group write requests, returns error as not supported.

methods.name: handle_register_single_read_packet
methods.description: Handles single register read requests, returns error as not supported.

methods.name: handle_register_single_write_packet
methods.description: Handles single register write requests, returns error as not supported.

methods.name: handle_memory_read_packet
methods.description: Handles memory read requests, retrieves memory content from registered regions.

methods.name: handle_memory_write_packet
methods.description: Handles memory write requests, not supported, returns error.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Main loop to process incoming GDB packets and dispatch to handlers.
